# Isaiah Chapter 30 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 33 verses]*

*Egypt alliance condemned; God waits to be gracious; teacher revealed; Assyria judged*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 30 (Woe to the Obstinate) addresses egypt alliance condemned; god waits to be gracious; teacher revealed; assyria judged. The key verse — "In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and trust shall be your strength" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
